day_shape: 68 items dominated by Khamenei funeral logistics across Qom, Najaf, Karbala and Mashhad following his reported killing, Qatari and Saudi tankers struck near Strait of Hormuz, IDF operations in Gaza and south Lebanon, and stalled Iran-US talks.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral procession across Iran and Iraq
threads.summary: Regime channels detailed multi-city funeral arrangements for Ali Khamenei, described as the 'martyred leader', with President Pezeshkian flying to Najaf and Iraqi PM receiving the cortege. Khamenei's office published the schedule: Qom Tuesday, Karbala/Najaf Wednesday 16 Tir, Mashhad burial to follow, with Ilam province closed Wednesday and 36 Red Crescent teams deployed to Iraq.

threads.label: Tanker attacks near Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: A Qatari LNG tanker (Al-Rekayat) and a Saudi-flagged oil tanker were struck near the Strait of Hormuz, with UKMTO confirming two attacks and Reuters obtaining a 'mayday' radio call describing a drone hit. Qatar called the strike an unacceptable attack on international navigation; IRIB cited an unnamed official saying transit is subject to 'Iranian arrangements' and any US escalation will meet an immediate response.

threads.label: Revenge rhetoric and axis solidarity messaging
threads.summary: Regime channels amplified vows of revenge for Khamenei's killing from Speaker Qalibaf, Quds Force commander Qaani, Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei (calling the strike on Khamenei's residence a war crime), Hassan Nasrallah's son, and Ansarallah's deputy media chief Nasruddin Amer, who said the movement is ready for ground war with Israel. Khamenei's office posted a message pledging 'decisive resolve for revenge'.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced killing Nukhba cell commander Ahmad Yahya Ibrahim Batsh and Hamas military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daqa in recent Gaza strikes. Israeli troops said they located RPG and anti-tank launchers, explosives and Hezbollah paraphernalia in a civilian bedroom in Tallousa in south Lebanon; Northern Command indicated no set deadline for evacuating positions across the Yellow Line.

threads.label: Iran-US talks stalled, Trump threats
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi said negotiations will not begin while Trump continues to threaten Iran with 'finishing the job'. Iran International reported commercial ship strikes near Hormuz came as Iran-US talks over waterway security stalled, with Tehran and Washington offering different accounts.

threads.label: Iran-linked plots and cyber activity abroad
threads.summary: A German court heard that an alleged IRGC-linked operative sought to pay a woman roughly €4,000 to firebomb a kosher shop, part of a wider plot against Jewish figures in Germany. Check Point reported an Iran-linked hacking group deployed a new framework targeting Israeli government bodies and IT firms.

threads.label: Iran human rights and health-care toll
threads.summary: Iran Human Rights reported at least 370 executions in the first half of 2026, including protesters and nine women. UN OCHA documented health-care being impacted by explosive weapons an average of 2.5 times daily during the recent conflict, including a drone strike on a Tehran children's hospital.

events.title: Commercial ships hit near Strait of Hormuz as Iran-US talks stall
events.summary: Commercial vessels were hit by missiles near the Strait of Hormuz early Tuesday as stalled negotiations between Iran and the United States over security in the strategic waterway came under renewed strain, with Tehran and Washington offering different accounts of the attacks.
